name: Brookfield Corporation
thesis: Three reinforcing compounders: (1) BAM fee-related earnings (capital-light, scaling with fundraising), (2) Brookfield Wealth Solutions earning an insurance spread above its cost of float, (3) a large carried-interest stack ($11.8B unrealized) monetizing on a multi-year cycle - the market underprices the TIMING/realization of this carry, not its existence. The bet: DE/share compounds 10-15% over a cycle while the buyback helps close the ~37% discount to ~$66 plan value, providing slow durable compounding plus real-asset (infra/power) diversification in a tech/beta-heavy book. HONEST CAVEAT: the inflation-hedge/diversifier framing is only PARTIAL - BN consolidates ~$250B of asset-level (non-recourse) debt, so levered real assets are also rate-sensitive; BN roughly halved in the 2022-23 rate shock and has historically moved WITH rate/inflation stress, not against it.
key_driver: DE/share growth via FRE compounding + BWS spread + carried-interest realization cadence

tier_1_kpis.name: Distributable Earnings (DE) per share growth YoY (TTM)
tier_1_kpis.current: DE before realizations $1.4B ($0.59/sh) +7% Q1'26; total DE $1.6B ($0.66/sh). Per-share aided by buyback.
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <10% YoY (TTM) for 2 consecutive Qs - the PM's compounding floor (matches the 10-15% target). NOTE: the European carry waterfall back-loads realizations, so pre-realization DE running ~7% is not itself a break.

tier_1_kpis.name: Fee-bearing capital growth
tier_1_kpis.current: $614B (+12% YoY); $67B raised YTD (incl. $40B Just Group mandate)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <5% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs (the leading indicator of future FRE)

tier_1_kpis.name: Carried interest - realized vs unrealized
tier_1_kpis.current: Unrealized accrued $11.8B; realized $157M Q1 / $528M LTM (~22x coverage). Mgmt guides a H2'26-2028 step-up (IFC Seoul recap, 17% IRR, closed post-Q1).
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: No advancement toward realization over a multi-year window (timing watch, NOT a hard per-Q break - per-Q floors are false-positive generators).

tier_1_kpis.name: Brookfield Wealth Solutions ROE
tier_1_kpis.current: ROE disclosed by issuer (floor >12%); BWS DE $430M (+11% YoY); insurance asset base ~$180B post-Just Group
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: BWS ROE <12% for 2 consecutive Qs (spread economics degrading)

tier_1_kpis.name: Discount to plan value
tier_1_kpis.current: Price ~$41 vs plan value ~$66.37 (~37% discount); mgmt targets plan value ~$140 by 2030. CAVEAT: plan value marks BN's ~73% BAM stake at BAM's market price (fell ~17% in Q1), so it is partly circular.
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Discount widens persistently despite ongoing buyback (market rejecting the SOTP)

tier_2_kpis.name: BEP / BIP / BBU distributions to BN

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Multi-year carried-interest realization drought (the $11.8B stack never converts)
NAV / plan-value discount widens despite buyback

nuance.bear_case: Carry realization is the load-bearing uncertainty: $11.8B accrued vs only $528M realized LTM (~22x), and mgmt says timing is 'slightly outside our control.' The inflation-hedge claim is partial - ~$250B of asset-level debt makes the infra/power book rate-sensitive, and BN roughly halved in 2022-23 when rates spiked. 'Plan value' is partly circular: it marks the ~73% BAM stake at BAM's price, which fell ~17% in Q1, mechanically cutting plan value even with stable fundamentals.
nuance.adversarial_take: DE before realizations grew only +7% - below the 10% floor - so the 10-15% compounding target leans on lumpy, back-loaded carry. The asset-management engine (FRE +11%, FBC +12%) is genuinely compounding; the risk is the timing of the payoff, not the existence of value.
nuance.stress_test: A multi-year realization drought + FRE decel below 8% + a widening discount despite buyback would break the compounding thesis. A sharp rate shock would pressure both the real-asset marks and the share price together (failing the 'diversifier' role).

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters - outright top-line contraction. (BN is a holdco/insurer; FCF-margin and OCF universals are intentionally omitted as they misfire on this structure.)

business_model_rules.kpi_name: Distributable Earnings (DE) per share growth YoY (TTM)
business_model_rules.narrative: DE/share growth <10% YoY (TTM) - the owner-economics floor (recalibrated from 15 to match the PM's 10-15% target; >15 would false-breach a 10-15% thesis).
BAM-segment FRE growth <8% YoY - asset-manager scale thesis weakens (recalibrated from 15; FRE is running +11%).
Fee-bearing capital growth <5% - the leading indicator of future FRE stalls (recalibrated from 10; FBC is running +12%).
BWS ROE <12% for 2Q - the insurance leg's spread economics are degrading (recalibrated from 15).
